metadata.description: Offline snapshot of NVIDIA listed-company supply-chain and partnership relations as of 5 September 2026.
metadata.scope: Associated listed companies in five relation types: supplier, customer, partner, investor_or_investee, and peer. Evidence is limited to legally accessible public documents accessed on or before the cut-off.
metadata.boundaries: No private contracts, no paywalled terminals, no login-gated datasets, no crawler that ignores robots.txt, and no Tier-2 suppliers that NVIDIA does not name. Dual-listed tickers use the primary exchange in the cited source. Nasdaq Trader DTN2026-8 maps Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A, CUSIP 84615Q103, to NASDAQ: SPCX; do not confuse with the prior unrelated SPCX symbol.
metadata.disclaimer: This dataset is research documentation for the ARTi challenge. It is not investment advice, not a recommendation to buy or sell any security, and not a complete picture of NVIDIA's commercial relationships.
unknowns: Revenue or volume shares by named customer are not disclosed in the FY2026 Form 10-K.
Foundry wafer split between TSMC and Samsung, and HBM split among SK hynix, Micron, and Samsung.
Whether Tesla remains a material NVIDIA customer versus an in-house SoC competitor.
13F also lists Coherent, Nokia, and Nebius; Generate Biomedicines is mapped as listed investee (GENB) plus an inferred GPU-customer row. BioNeMo/CUDA SKU claims are not in the cited locators.
Arm and SoundHound positions in the prior 2023-12-31 13F are no longer in the 2026-06-30 13F.
metadata.scoring_method: confidence_score is the sum of source_authority (max 40), independence_directness (max 25), timeliness vs 2026-09-05 cut-off (max 20), and quantifiable_info (max 15). relevance_score is a separate 0-100 operational-importance judgment.

relations.quantifiable_info: FY2026 10-K names TSMC as a foundry used to produce NVIDIA semiconductor wafers. No wafer-share percentage is disclosed.
relations.score_explanation: source_authority 40/40 FY2026 Form 10-K; independence_directness 25/25 named foundry; timeliness 20/20 filed 25 Feb 2026; quantifiable_info 10/15 role named, no split. CoWoS exclusivity is not claimed.
relations.entity_disambiguation: TSMC / Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited, NYSE: TSM (ADR).
relations.uncertainty_notes: Samsung is named as a second foundry in the same sentence.
relations.source_conflict_notes: None for the foundry naming.

relations.direction: NVIDIA -> GPU compute / DGX Cloud Lepton -> Amazon Web Services

relations.score_explanation: source_authority 34/40 NVIDIA newsroom; independence_directness 12/25 first-party PR; timeliness 16/20 11 Jun 2025 versus 5 Sep 2026 cut-off; quantifiable_info 12/15 named as first large-scale CSP participant, no units.
relations.entity_disambiguation: Amazon.com, Inc., NASDAQ: AMZN; consuming unit Amazon Web Services, Inc.
relations.uncertainty_notes: Does not prove AWS is NVIDIA's largest customer.
relations.source_conflict_notes: FY2026 10-K also lists Amazon as a cloud company with internal accelerated-computing designs (peer). This row records the customer/hosting direction from the newsroom locator.

relations.direction: NVIDIA / NVentures -> equity holding -> Generate Biomedicines
relations.quantifiable_info: 13F-HR period ended 30 Jun 2026: GENERATE BIOMEDICINES INC COM SHS, CUSIP 370920100, 833,325 shares; value column 14058193 as printed. Company PR 14 Sep 2023 named NVentures, NVIDIA's venture capital arm, as a new Series C investor in a $273 million round (origin of the relationship; not the current share count).
relations.score_explanation: source_authority 40/40 13F-HR; independence_directness 25/25 statutory table; timeliness 19/20 30 Jun 2026 / filed 14 Aug 2026; quantifiable_info 15/15 exact share count. Series C names NVentures but is not used as the share-count source.
relations.entity_disambiguation: Generate Biomedicines, Inc., NASDAQ: GENB, CUSIP 370920100, IPO about 27 Feb 2026. Not Recursion (RXRX) or other Flagship AI-biotech names.
relations.uncertainty_notes: 13F does not disclose NVentures versus other NVIDIA vehicles, board rights, or remaining Series C ownership percentage.
relations.source_conflict_notes: Series C PR (14 Sep 2023) and the 2026 13F are consistent on NVIDIA-affiliated ownership; they measure different dates and instruments.

evidence.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (NVIDIA Form 13F-HR)
evidence.evidence_locator: INFORMATION TABLE row: GENERATE BIOMEDICINES INC COM SHS 370920100 14058193 833325 SH SOLE 833325; accession 0001045810-26-000065.

relations.quantifiable_info: The 14 Sep 2023 Generate PR states a machine-learning-powered generative biology platform and names NVentures as a Series C investor. That supports an inference that Generate consumes NVIDIA accelerated compute. The locator does not name H100, A100, DGX, CUDA, or BioNeMo, and does not quantify GPU spend.
relations.score_explanation: source_authority 32/40 company PR; independence_directness 12/25 first-party, no purchase order; timeliness 8/20 Sep 2023 versus Sep 2026 cut-off; quantifiable_info 4/15 platform described, no SKUs or dollars. SKU-level customer claims are withheld as unlocated.
relations.entity_disambiguation: Same NASDAQ: GENB entity as genb-13f.
relations.uncertainty_notes: Generate could train on non-NVIDIA accelerators or rented cloud GPUs not sold as NVIDIA revenue. BioNeMo/CUDA 'full-stack partner' language was not found in the cited PR or the FY2026 10-K.
relations.source_conflict_notes: Do not treat the investee fact row as proof of a customer contract. Dual role is investee (confirmed) plus customer (inferred only).
